entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: A partial solar eclipse occurred at the Moon's descending node of orbit on Tuesday, April 8, 1902, with a magnitude of 0.0643. A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between Earth and the Sun, thereby totally or partly obscuring the image of the Sun for a viewer on Earth. A partial solar eclipse occurs in the polar regions of the Earth when the center of the Moon's shadow misses the Earth.
